fusions.name: Howler's Pitch
fusions.desc: Looses a shriek 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Pilfer
fusions.desc: A quick rake in the dark that deals 4 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Flit to the Rafters
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Roost Instinct
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
